# Catalyst Labs agent tools

> Hosted MCP tools on Apify. Structured JSON, pay per use, failed items never charged, explicit errors instead of guesses. Connect: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/<tool> (Apify OAuth or Bearer token).

## Tools
- [Agent Web Reader](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/agent-web-reader): Web search or URLs in, clean markdown out, one JSON row per page with source URL, title and status. $0.002 per page, $0.003 per search; failed URLs never charged. Token budget per result, HTML and PDF, errors returned as rows instead of crashing the call. Built for agents. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/agent-web-reader
- [Document to Markdown](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/document-to-markdown): PDF, Word, Excel, CSV and HTML to clean markdown for agents and RAG: tables kept, PDF page markers, optional chunks with heading and page. $0.001 per page; failed or scanned files never charged. One row per document with status and error reason. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/document-to-markdown
- [Google Trends API](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/google-trends-api): Google Trends as clean JSON for agents: interest over time, by region, related and rising queries, plus a ready trend summary (peak, average, % change, rising/falling). $0.0025 per keyword; rate-limited or failed keywords never charged. Honest RATE_LIMITED errors. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/google-trends-api
- [YouTube Transcript API](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/youtube-transcript-api): YouTube transcripts with timestamps and metadata from videos, Shorts, playlists, channels or search, in bulk. 12/12 in our head-to-head test, with zero failures charged. Flags auto vs human captions. Text, LLM-ready text, SRT, VTT. Videos without captions never charged. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/youtube-transcript-api
- [Podcast Transcript API](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/podcast-transcript-api): Podcast transcripts from RSS feeds, Apple Podcasts links, episode pages or audio URLs. Uses the publisher's own transcript for a flat $0.01 when one exists, Whisper large-v3 otherwise ($0.009/min). Budget checked before each episode, so it never overspends. Text, segments, SRT, VTT, MD. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/podcast-transcript-api
- [Website Screenshot & PDF API](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/website-screenshot-pdf-api): Full-page screenshots (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and PDFs of any URL, in bulk, with cookie banners removed and lazy images loaded. Failed, blocked or blank pages never charged and come back with a reason and fix hint. Desktop, tablet and mobile. Agent-callable via MCP. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/website-screenshot-pdf-api
- [Career Site Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/career-site-jobs-scraper): Live open jobs from the career sites of companies you name, on 17 ATS (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Oracle…), in one schema with yearly salary, remote and apply URL. Not-found companies and errors never charged. Feed of new and closed jobs. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/career-site-jobs-scraper
- [City Council & Public Meeting Transcripts](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/city-council-meeting-transcripts): Timestamped city council and county board transcripts tied to agenda items and official votes. Granicus, Swagit, Legistar and YouTube; type a city or paste URLs. $0.008 per audio minute; list meetings first for $0.002 each. Keyword alerts and new-meeting monitoring. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/city-council-meeting-transcripts
- [Local Decision Check (Iowa)](https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/local-government-decision-lookup): Verification step after a meeting or transcript search: check an Iowa council or county board claim against official minutes. Returns supported, contradicted or no_record with tally, no voters, amount, minutes link. 82 governments, 21,097 votes, 0.45% audited error. $0.005/lookup.

## All tools in one MCP URL
https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/agent-web-reader,catalyst-labs/document-to-markdown,catalyst-labs/google-trends-api,catalyst-labs/youtube-transcript-api,catalyst-labs/podcast-transcript-api,catalyst-labs/website-screenshot-pdf-api,catalyst-labs/career-site-jobs-scraper,catalyst-labs/city-council-meeting-transcripts,catalyst-labs/local-government-decision-lookup
